title: Page 3
content_zh:
戚无秋纳闷地看着她到底想干什么，一双眉挑得高高的，耐着性子等待。
过没多久她终于回到他的面前，非常恭敬的双手奉上湿布巾，有礼地说：「三公子，请擦脸。」
「呃？」他有种想翻白眼的冲动，难道她看不出来他早已梳洗完毕了？「我已经擦过脸，甚至连衣裳都已经换了，你没注意吗？」
她先是一愣，才后知后觉地点点头。「啊，对耶……」
这下子戚无秋还真的翻起白眼来了，怀疑这个丫头到底是真的呆，还是故意装傻在耍他。
看到主子表情有些不满，草儿开始慌了起来，她赶紧将布巾放回水盆，然后急着想冲出房。「奴……奴婢去帮三公子端早膳。」
「丫头，回来。」他没好气地马上叫住她。
本想离开的小身子顿了一下，之后还是走回戚无秋面前，胆怯地问：「三公子……不吃饭吗？」
相信我，三公子绝对不会吃人……
但她现在看来，主子的表情却很可怕，像是随时都会吃人一样，她本来还以为戚管家是好人，绝对不会骗她，结果她还是被骗了。
呜呜……她很瘦、很小、没什么肉，她不想被吃呀……
戚无秋瞪了她一眼，她那什么表情？好像他会直接把她给生吞活剥一样。「都已经快近午了，我早就已经用过早膳，你可以不必忙了。」
「喔。」原来他已经吃过了。这让她瞬间松了一口气，放心地应答。
戚无秋这时才有心思仔细地瞧着她，发现她的五官很精致，细细的柳眉、小小的樱唇、圆润的双眼，虽然不是抢眼亮丽的那一型女人，却像个温婉可人的大家闺秀，可说是非常的有气质。
她一点都不像是当丫鬟的料，反而像是走错地方的大小姐，只可惜这些都只是外表的假相，才刚和她相处一小段时间，他就发现她其实是个傻气的小丫头，一点都不聪明伶俐。
「你叫什么名字？」
「奴婢叫草儿。」她恭敬地回答。
「你是这一次抽中签王的丫鬟？」如果真的是，那倒是有些糟糕。
她点点头。「奴婢会认真服侍三公子三个月的。」
「你不怕我？」他挑了下眉，刻意吓唬她。

他脾气冲动又火爆，早上起床的时候更是他最无法控制情绪的时候，会做出什么事情连他自己都无法控制，丫鬟们就是因为这样才不敢来他这当差，这个丫头刚才也已经尝到苦头了，难道还不怕他？
草儿顿了一下，之后还是诚实地回答：「怕……」
下意识摸着自己的脖子，她好怕再被主子给掐住，主子的起床气实在是太可怕了，难怪其他姊妹们都不想来这里当差。
不过她要忍耐，戚管家说，只要待三个月就好，三个月一到，她就可以回去扫她的地，暂时不必换工作了。
第1章(2)
戚无秋随着她的动作注意到她那纤细的脖子，才发现脖子上头似乎有淡淡的瘀痕浮现，这让他不由得心虚，总觉得对她非常的过意不去。
说实话，她其实很顺他的眼，看起来也乖乖的，很听话的感觉，不像其他调过来的丫鬟，一开始就把他当成像是毒蛇猛兽一般，怕他简直到了一种让人感到好笑的程度。
但她却不太一样，就算怕，她也很坦然地面对他，让他对她的第一印象就比其他的丫鬟们好，对她存有某种程度的好感。
而且她长得也很不错，很赏心悦目，有这种丫鬟在身边，没什么不好的。
只不过她太迟钝了，而他太过粗鲁，如果真的把她留下当贴身丫鬟，不必三个月，他怕不出三天她就会遍体鳞伤，害他落了一个虐待下人的罪名。
所以绝对不能把这样一个傻丫头给留在身边，为了彼此都好，他还是要戚管家再换另外一个丫鬟来吧。
内心打定主意之后，戚无秋便说：「草儿，我让戚管家将你调回原来工作的地方去，好吗？」
「呃？」没想到草儿不但没有欣喜若狂，反倒是水眸泛泪，一脸委屈地瞧着他。「三公子，您……不要奴婢了，是吗？」
「啊？」她的反应完全出乎他的预料，本以为她会迫不及待地马上答应的。「让你回去原来的地方工作不好吗？你在这里根本就……」
「三公子您真的不要奴婢……」草儿沮丧地低下头，鼻音越来越浓厚。「奴婢又搞砸新工作了，戚管家一定会很失望的……」
她已经让戚管家失望很多次，不希望继续再让戚管家失望下去，所以就算待在新主子身边会让她有些怕怕的，她还是会努力待下来，努力适应新工作。结果新主子却不到一天就要将她给退回去，她会很对不起戚管家的，她已经快没有脸面对他老人家了……
她越想越伤心，蓦地低声啜泣起来。
这让从来就不善于应付女人的戚无秋更是头大，真是不知道该拿这个丫头怎么办才好。
「喂喂喂，你到底在哭什么，我只是要你回到原来的地方，又不是要赶你出戚家。」他根本就不会安慰人，越是急躁语气就越不好。
「呜……三公子不要奴婢了……」她继续哭，越哭越可怜。

「这件事情真的有那么严重吗？你如果笑我还可以理解，你哭我才真的觉得莫名其妙。」
「呜呜……三公子不要奴婢了……」
「不是我不要你，只不过你真的不适合待在这，你还是回去原来的地方会比较好。」该死，不要再哭了！
「呜呜呜……三公子不……」
「够了，住嘴！」戚无秋终于受不了的抓狂咆哮出声，吓得草儿马上乖乖闭嘴，但眼眶中的泪水还是不断滑落，那楚楚可怜的眼神直瞧着他，害他又莫名其妙心虚起来，好像他把她给遣回去是多么罪大恶极的一件事一样。
但他根本就没有做错呀，要她回去是为了她的一条小命着想，要不然他真的不知道哪天自己会再次失手掐住连躲都不会躲的她，害她无辜的小命断送在他的手上。
不能心软，他绝对不能心软，就算这个小丫头再怎样表现出楚楚可怜、万般委屈的模样，都不能够再将她给留下来，免得到最后是害人害己。
他态度强硬地命令她。「把你脸上的泪水给擦干净，我马上带你去找戚管家，要他把你给调回去，再换一个新的丫鬟来。」
戚无秋的动作像一阵风，快速地越过穿廊，带着草儿去找戚管家，他的性子急，有什么事情能尽快处理就处理，不喜欢一直拖下去。
而动作慢、脚步小的草儿，只能非常努力地在他后头追着，她追得很辛苦，不想被他给彻底抛下。
好不容易在前院找到戚管家的身影，戚无秋赶紧将话给挑明，他不要草儿当他的贴身丫鬟，要戚管家再换另一个丫鬟过来。
结果戚管家听到是脸色大变，不顾尊卑之分的强硬拒绝。「不行，绝对不能换丫鬟！三公子，您这三个月的丫鬟就是草儿，已经没有任何的转圜余地了。」
「为什么？」他不满地大皱着眉。
「绝对不能坏了规矩，要是奴才这次让三公子换掉草儿，往后绝对会有其他丫鬟如法炮制让三公子换掉她，这样子绝对没完没了。」
戚无秋火大地揪住戚总管的衣领，只差没粗鲁地将他给摔出去。「戚总管，我不管你到底有几百、几千种理由，总而言之，这个丫鬟我是换定了！」怎么连换个丫鬟都这么麻烦，他到底还是不是主子呀？
content_en:
Qi Wuqiu looked at her in confusion as to what she wanted to do. He raised his eyebrows high and waited patiently.
Not long after, she finally returned to him. She held a wet cloth with both hands in a very respectful manner and said politely, "Third Young Master, please wipe your face."
"Huh?" He had the urge to roll his eyes. Couldn't she tell that he had already finished dressing up? "I've already wiped my face and even changed my clothes. Didn't you notice?"
She was stunned for a moment, then nodded belatedly. "Ah, yes..."
At this moment, Qi Wuqiu really rolled his eyes, wondering whether this girl was really stupid or was pretending to be stupid to trick him.
Seeing her master's dissatisfied expression, Cao'er began to panic. She quickly put the cloth back into the basin and rushed out of the room. "Slave...servant, please go help Third Young Master with breakfast."
"Girl, come back." He immediately stopped her angrily.
The little body that wanted to leave paused for a moment, then walked back to Qi Wuqiu and asked timidly: "Third Young Master... don't you want to eat?"
Believe me, the Third Young Master will never eat people...
But now it seemed to her that the master's expression was very scary, as if he was about to eat someone at any time. She originally thought that Butler Qi was a good person and would never lie to her, but in the end she was still lied to.
Woohoo... She is very thin, small, and has no meat. She doesn't want to be eaten...
Qi Wuqiu glared at her, what was her expression? As if he would just eat her alive. "It's almost noon. I've already had breakfast, so you don't have to be busy."
"Oh." Turns out he had already eaten. This made her instantly relieved and answered with confidence.
Only then did Qi Wuqiu have the intention to look at her carefully, and found that her facial features were very delicate, with slender eyebrows, small cherry lips, and round eyes. Although she was not an eye-catching and beautiful woman, she looked like a gentle and lovely lady. She was very temperamental.
She didn't look like a maid at all, but rather like a young lady who had gone to the wrong place. Unfortunately, these were just false appearances. After spending a short time with her, he discovered that she was actually a silly little girl, not smart at all.
"What's your name?"
"My name is Cao'er." She replied respectfully.
"Are you the maid who won the lottery this time?" If it was true, that would be a bit bad.
She nodded. "This slave will serve the Third Young Master seriously for three months."
"Aren't you afraid of me?" He raised his eyebrows, deliberately trying to scare her.
He has an impulsive and hot temper, and when he gets up in the morning, he is the most unable to control his emotions. Even he can't control what he will do. This is why the maids dare not come to his job. This girl has already experienced the pain just now, isn't she still afraid of him?
Cao'er paused for a moment, and then answered honestly: "I'm afraid..."
Subconsciously touching her neck, she was so afraid of being choked by her master again. His anger when getting up was really terrible. No wonder the other sisters didn't want to work here.
But she has to be patient. Butler Qi said that she only needs to stay for three months. Once the three months are up, she can go back to sweep her floor and there is no need to change jobs for the time being.
Chapter 1(2)
Qi Wuqiu followed her movements and noticed her slender neck, and found that there seemed to be faint bruises on her neck. This made him feel guilty and felt very sorry for her.
To be honest, she was actually very pleasing to his eyes, and she seemed to be well-behaved and obedient. Unlike other maids who were transferred here, she treated him as a poisonous snake and beast from the beginning, and was afraid of him to the point of making people laugh.
But she was different. Even if she was afraid, she faced him calmly, making his first impression of her better than that of the other maids, and he had a certain degree of fondness for her.
And she is also very good-looking, very pleasing to the eye, such a maidThere is nothing bad about being around.
It's just that she is too slow, and he is too rude. If he really keeps her as his personal maid, it won't take three months. He is afraid that within three days, she will be covered with bruises, making him guilty of abusing a servant.
So he absolutely couldn't keep such a silly girl by his side. For the sake of both sides, he had better ask Butler Qi to replace him with another maid.
After making up his mind, Qi Wuqiu said, "Cao'er, I'll ask Butler Qi to transfer you back to your original place of work, okay?"
"Huh?" Unexpectedly, Cao'er was not overjoyed, but instead looked at him with tears in her eyes. "Third Young Master, you... don't want to be a slave anymore, right?"
"Huh?" Her reaction was completely beyond his expectation. He thought she would agree immediately. "Wouldn't it be better for you to go back to work where you came from? You're simply not here..."
"Third Young Master, you really don't want to be a slave..." Cao'er lowered his head in frustration, his nasal voice getting thicker and thicker. "My slave has messed up her new job again. Butler Qi will be very disappointed..."
She has disappointed Butler Qi many times and does not want to disappoint Butler Qi again, so even if she is a little scared to stay with the new master, she will still try to stay and adapt to the new job. As a result, the new master will send her back in less than a day. She will be very sorry for Butler Qi. She almost has no face to face him...
The more she thought about it, the sadder she became, and she suddenly began to sob softly.
This made Qi Wuqiu, who had never been good at dealing with women, even more confused. He really didn't know what to do with this girl.
"Hey, hey, hey, what are you crying about? I just want you to go back to where you came from. I don't want to drive you out of Qi's home." He didn't know how to comfort people at all, and the more irritable his tone, the worse it was.
"Oh... Third Young Master, I don't want to be a slave anymore..." She continued to cry, the more she cried, the more pitiful she became.
"Is this really that serious? I can understand it if you laugh, but I find it really baffling if you cry."
"Uuuu... Third Young Master no longer wants to be a slave..."
"It's not that I don't want you, it's just that you are really not suitable to stay here. It would be better for you to go back to your original place." Damn it, stop crying!
"Uuuuuuu... Third Young Master, no..."
"That's enough, shut up!" Qi Wuqiu finally couldn't stand it anymore and roared wildly. Cao'er was so scared that he immediately shut up, but the tears in his eyes kept falling. Those pitiful eyes looked directly at him, which made him feel guilty inexplicably, as if it was such a heinous crime for him to send her back.
But he didn't do anything wrong at all. He asked her to go back for the sake of her life. Otherwise, he really didn't know that one day he would accidentally pinch her again, who couldn't even hide, and her innocent life would be ruined in his hands.
He must not be soft-hearted. He must not be soft-hearted. No matter how pitiful and aggrieved this little girl is, he cannot keep her here, lest she end up harming others and herself.
He ordered her forcefully. "Wipe the tears off your face. I'll take you to Butler Qi immediately and ask him to transfer you back and replace you with a new maid."
Qi Wuqiu's movements were like a gust of wind, quickly crossing the corridor and taking Cao'er to find Butler Qi. He had an impatient temper and would handle any matter as quickly as possible, and didn't like to keep delaying it.
As for Cao'er, who was slow and small, she could only chase after him very hard. She chased very hard and didn't want to be completely abandoned by him.
After finally finding Butler Qi in the front yard, Qi Wuqiu quickly made it clear that he did not want Cao'er to be his personal maid, and wanted Butler Qi to replace him with another maid.
As a result, Butler Qi's face changed drastically when he heard it, and he refused firmly regardless of the distinction between superiority and inferiority. "No, you absolutely can't change the maid! Third Young Master, in the past three months, you haveThe maid is nothing but Cao'er, and there is no room for change. "
"Why?" He frowned dissatisfied.
"We must not break the rules. If I let the Third Young Master replace Cao'er this time, other maids will definitely follow the same pattern and ask the Third Young Master to replace her. This will never end."
Qi Wuqiu Huo Dadi grabbed Manager Qi's collar and barely managed to throw him out roughly. "Mr. Qi, I don't care whether you have hundreds or thousands of reasons. All in all, I have decided to change this maid!" Why is it so troublesome to even change the maid? Is he still the master?
